LESSON: SOCIAL MEDIA

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.5: Social Media

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Social Media
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: when using social media platforms, Why should you be cautious when using social media?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify different social media platforms used by young people today
2. describe ways of using social media responsibly
3. discuss ways they should respond to cyberbullying
4. apply Christian values as they use different social media platforms, g) desire to use social media responsibly

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
